ok, I need to say something because I’m really pissed off.

Back on Aug 30 I posted the flash sheet I drew for our Sept 13 flash day. I drew the whole thing by hand over a few weekends, including the switchblade moth. Someone got that design tattooed in the first hour of flash day. It was meant to be a one-time design, sold to one person. That’s the deal with my flash, and the client paid for that.

Tonight I found out a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling it as a “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” for $6.50, or 3 for $15. It’s not just a moth with a knife. It has the same crack in the blade, the same wing pattern, and they didn’t even flip it. It’s a straight scan of my linework, not “inspired by” anything.

I messaged them and asked them to take it down. The reply was basically “love your work,” then “moths are a common motif,” and if I have a registered copyright, send it through their support form. Very helpful. I’m not a lawyer, and most small shops and independent artists don’t have lawyer money. These sticker places know that, and it’s infuriating.

I also want to make this clear to the person who got the tattoo: I did not sell your tattoo or give anyone permission to print it. You came to me for a one-of-one flash design, and that’s what I agreed to. I’m sorry you even had to wonder if I was behind this. I’m not going to name you or put your business out here.

If you want to help, please report the listing to StickerBurrow and don’t buy from them. I’m not asking anyone to harass anybody or go after their other stuff—just report the listing and let them know copying someone’s actual drawing isn’t okay.

And please don’t tag the shop page in this. This is my personal post, not a statement from Salt & Sparrow. I’m speaking for myself, about my own work. Thanks to everyone who’s had my back tonight.
